verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a web-data API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows versioned endpoints or a documented API deprecation and sunset policy. The only deprecation mention is a rebrand notice that the Brand.dev domain and package names are deprecated (context-dev-docs-28), which is a naming change, not an API lifecycle policy. The OpenAPI spec probe confirms only that a spec exists, not that versions are tracked.
